name: Beef and Cabbage Skillet
summary: Ground beef, cabbage, and rice cooked down in one pan with tomato.
instructions: Cook the rice according to package directions and set aside.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the ground beef and cook 6–7 minutes, breaking it up, until browned. Drain excess fat.
Add the onion and cook 4 minutes, then add the garlic and paprika for 30 seconds.
Add the shredded cabbage and cook 6–8 minutes, stirring, until wilted.
Pour in the diced tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes until saucy. Season with salt and pepper.
Fold in the cooked rice, heat through, and serve.
budgetNotes: You buy a whole head of cabbage; the rest keeps for slaw or soup.
Medium ground beef is cheaper than lean and the tomato covers the extra fat — drain it well.
